source.title: 足球彩票量化预测系统：全网深度调研与Agent开发执行规范

tier_policy.A: Previously audited (accepted, rejected or conditional): reuse recorded decisions and evidence; do not redo work.
tier_policy.B: partially validated: identify precise gap and defer until research-changing
tier_policy.C: new incremental discovery: check original source; do isolated follow-up only where high value
tier_policy.D: rejected or not presently relevant: avoid work
